description.short: Cardigan Bay Active is an AALA-licensed adventure activity centre based on the River Teifi in Cardigan, West Wales. Operating since 2011 under Adventure Beyond Ltd, they offer coasteering, sea and river kayaking, white water rafting, stand-up paddleboarding, canoe trips, bushcraft, surfing, climbing, archery, and equipment hire across Ceredigion and Pembrokeshire.
description.shortNote: Drafted from verified website content. Ready for editorial review.
description.full:
Established in the spring of 2011, Cardigan Bay Active is the adventure brand of Adventure Beyond Ltd, a family-run outdoor activity centre with roots going back to 1997. Based at the Scout Hall Boat House on the Strand in Cardigan, their riverside centre sits below the historic Cardigan Castle on the banks of the River Teifi.

Cardigan Bay Active holds an AALA licence (L179742, valid to August 2027) and is accredited as a WISE wildlife-safe operator and an approved Duke of Edinburgh activity provider. The team of 17+ instructors and support staff hold national-level coaching qualifications across paddlesports, coasteering, climbing, and outdoor education.

On the water, the operator offers canoe trips through the Teifi Gorge nature reserve, white water rafting on a 9km river section with three rapid sections, river and sea kayaking tours, stand-up paddleboarding, and white water tubing. On land, sessions include bushcraft, rock climbing and abseiling, surfing on the West Wales coast, and archery and axe throwing. Most guided activities run as 2.5–3 hour sessions starting at 09:30 or 13:30. A riverside equipment hire service is also available on a first-come basis. Wildlife encounters — dolphins, seals, kingfishers, ospreys — are a regular highlight of river and coastal tours.
